notes.title: a new game from the yapori show universe is coming in 2026
notes.content:
[p]Hello players, I must announce that a new game called Yapori Dimensions of Action and Adventure is coming soon to Steam in the year 2026!!!!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4020720/Yapori_Dimenses/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Small update
notes.content: Small update of The Yapori Clicker, adding the logo to the menu and adding some extras to the game menu

notes.title: New Game
notes.content: A New Game From The Yapori Show Universe Is Coming, Please Add It To Your Wishlist

notes.title: Important announcement
notes.content: Hello players, previously Yapori Minigames and Yapori Clicker were going to be removed from Steam, but we decided to go back on that decision, both games will remain on Steam, thank you for your attention, and we are already working on a next game in the Yapori Show universe, stay tuned.

notes.content:
Hello players, Yapori Minigames 2 will be released soon, stay tuned and don't miss the launch and future updates of the game :)
